```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import {TABS, parseHash, toHash, resolveTeam} from "./explorer/state.js"
import {sourceLine, errorCard, loadOnce, escapeHtml} from "./explorer/ui.js"
import {
  formatRecord, teamGames, effectiveGame, landscapePanels, timelineFor, parsePlayers,
  defaultShowFcs, focusedConference, shouldLoadPlays, stepPlay, playWhen, playAnnouncement
} from "./explorer/teams.js"
import {readShard, gameRows, playsShardPath, hyparquetUrl} from "./explorer/plays.js"
import {
  TIERS, positionGroups, resolvePlayersPos, positionStats, formatStat, ordinal, swarmRows,
  beeswarm, careerRows, seasonForPlayer, careerPercentiles, searchPlayers, groupPlural
} from "./explorer/players.js"
import {
  columnsToRows, resolveCombinePos, combinePoints, missingCount, formatMeasure, canOpenPlayer, combineTraces
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
mutable retry = 0
tabCache = new Map()
mutable teamsRetry = 0
mutable focusConf = null
mutable scrubPlay = null
// Latches true once the Game section has been in view (or a game was picked):
// the play-by-play is not fetched until then (plans/explorer.md step 3).
mutable gameInView = false
// Which Prev/Next button to refocus after the play card is redrawn.
navFocus = ({key: null})
mutable playersRetry = 0
mutable combineRetry = 0
// The invitee the reader tapped in the 3D scatter.
mutable combinePick = null
// The hyparquet module, imported once per page (a retry busts the failed import).
function loadHyparquet(n) {
  const url = hyparquetUrl("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/hyparquet@1/+esm", n);
  return loadOnce(tabCache, url, () => import(url));
}
async function fetchJson(path) {
  const response = await fetch(new URL(path, document.baseURI));
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`${response.status} ${path}`);
  return response.json();
}
// Raw markup from ui.js becomes a DOM node. OJS inspects a node that still
// has a parent instead of mounting it, so detach it from the wrapper first.
function asNode(markup) {
  const el = document.createElement("div");
  el.innerHTML = markup;
  const node = el.firstElementChild;
  node.remove();
  return node;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// The first view: meta, teams and team seasons (~50 KB gzipped).
shell = {
  retry;
  try {
    const [meta, teams, teamSeason] = await Promise.all([
      FileAttachment("explorer-data/meta.json").json(),
      FileAttachment("explorer-data/teams.json").json(),
      FileAttachment("explorer-data/team_season.json").json()
    ]);
    return {meta, teams, teamSeason, teamById: new Map(teams.map(t => [t.team_id, t]))};
  } catch (error) {
    return {error};
  }
}
// Cells below read `ready`, which never resolves after a failed load, so
// they wait quietly behind the error card instead of throwing.
ready = shell.error ? new Promise(() => {}) : shell
```

```{ojs}
  card.querySelector("button").onclick = () => { mutable retry = retry + 1; };
  return card;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Hash state, re-read when the reader edits the hash or presses back.
hashState = Generators.observe(notify => {
  const read = () => {
    const s = parseHash(location.hash, ready.meta);
    s.team = resolveTeam(s.team, ready.teams, ready.meta);
    notify(s);
  };
  read();
  // hashchange also fires for Back/Forward between hash entries.
  addEventListener("hashchange", read);
  return () => removeEventListener("hashchange", read);
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
```
```{ojs}
// A tap sets an input the way a reader would, then scrolls to the next level.
pick = {
  const set = (view, value) => {
    view.value = value;
    view.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
  };
  // A pinned header (wider screens) sits 60px down and covers the top of the
  // section, so land below it. On phones it scrolls away, so land just below
  // the pinned navbar instead.
  const scroll = id => {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    const head = document.querySelector(".explorer-header");
    if (!el) return;
    const navH = document.getElementById("quarto-header")?.offsetHeight || 60;
    const sticky = head && getComputedStyle(head).position === "sticky";
    const offset = sticky ? head.getBoundingClientRect().height + 60 + 8 : navH + 8;
    window.scrollTo({top: el.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - offset, behavior: "smooth"});
    // Move focus to the opened level's heading, so keyboard and screen-reader
    // users land on it instead of the body.
    el.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
    el.focus({preventScroll: true});
  };
  return {
    team: id => { set(viewof team, id); scroll("teams-team"); },
    season: s => { set(viewof season, s); scroll("teams-season"); },
    game: id => { mutable gameInView = true; set(viewof game, id); scroll("teams-game"); },
    // A player opens on the Players tab, at their position group when known
    // (and in a given season, e.g. the last college season before a combine).
    player: (id, group, inSeason) => {
      if (group) set(viewof pos, group);
      if (inSeason && ready.meta.seasons.includes(inSeason)) set(viewof season, inSeason);
      set(viewof player, id === null ? null : String(id));
      if (viewof tab.value !== "players") {
        set(viewof tab, "players");
        // Wait for the tab to unhide (the hider cell runs after this input).
        setTimeout(() => scroll("tab-players"), 150);
      } else {
        scroll("players-landscape");
      }
    },
    pos: group => { set(viewof pos, group); set(viewof player, null); },
    seasonOnly: s => set(viewof season, s)
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
```
```{ojs}
// Write every key back; the first write replaces the bare URL instead of
// adding a history entry.
{
  // A failed season fetch leaves the team's games unknown, so keep the shared
  // link's game= rather than dropping it.
  if (seasonGamesData.error) return;
  // Only the reader's own game pick goes into the hash; the default game is implied.
  const gameKey = teamSeasonGames.some(g => g.game_id === game) ? game : null;
  const next = toHash({...hashState, tab, season, team, game: gameKey, pos, player});
  if (next === location.hash) return;
  // Push only input-driven changes. A write that merely canonicalizes the
  // live URL replaces it, so Back never lands on a non-canonical entry.
  const cur = parseHash(location.hash, ready.meta);
  cur.team = resolveTeam(cur.team, ready.teams, ready.meta);
  if (cur.team === team && cur.season === season && !teamSeasonGames.some(g => g.game_id === cur.game)) cur.game = null;
  if (!location.hash || toHash(cur) === next) history.replaceState(null, "", next);
  else history.pushState(null, "", next);
}
```

### Conferences {#teams-landscape}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Starts on when the selected team is FCS in the selected season; picking an
// FCS team (or changing season) sets it again.
viewof showFcs = Inputs.toggle({label: "Show FCS", value: defaultShowFcs(ready.teamSeason, team, season)})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
landscape = {
  const classification = showFcs ? "fcs" : "fbs";
  const panels = landscapePanels(ready.teamSeason, season, classification);
  const metric = classification === "fbs" ? "elo_end" : "win_pct";
  const yLabel = metric === "elo_end" ? "End-of-season Elo" : "Win share";
  const value = d => metric === "elo_end" ? `Elo ${d.elo_end}` : `${Math.round(d.win_pct * 100)}% wins`;
  const color = id => ready.teamById.get(id)?.color ?? "#6b7280";
  const name = id => ready.teamById.get(id)?.team ?? String(id);
  const focused = panels.find(p => p.conference === focusedConference(focusConf, panels, team));
  if (!focused) {
    // Small multiples: the selected team's line in its color, the rest grey.
    const grid = html`<div class="explorer-panels"></div>`;
    for (const p of panels) {
      const fig = Plot.plot({
        height: 150, marginLeft: 44, style: {fontSize: "13px"},
        x: {label: null, tickFormat: String, ticks: 4},
        y: {label: null, ticks: 3},
        marks: [
          Plot.ruleX([season], {stroke: "#9ca3af", strokeDasharray: "3,3"}),
          Plot.line(p.rows, {
            x: "season", y: metric, z: "team_id",
            stroke: d => d.team_id === team ? color(team) : "#9ca3af",
            strokeWidth: d => d.team_id === team ? 3 : 1,
            strokeOpacity: d => d.team_id === team ? 1 : 0.5
          })
        ]
      });
      const card = html`<button type="button" class="explorer-panel" aria-label="${`Open ${p.conference}`}"><h4>${p.conference}</h4>${fig}</button>`;
      card.onclick = () => { mutable focusConf = p.conference; };
      grid.append(card);
    }
    return grid;
  }
  // One conference, large: tap near a line (or a chip) to open that team.
  const fig = Plot.plot({
    height: 360, marginLeft: 56, style: {fontSize: "16px"},
    x: {label: "Season", tickFormat: String},
    y: {label: yLabel, grid: true},
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleX([season], {stroke: "#9ca3af", strokeDasharray: "4,4"}),
      Plot.line(focused.rows, {
        x: "season", y: metric, z: "team_id",
        stroke: d => color(d.team_id),
        strokeWidth: d => d.team_id === team ? 4 : 1.5,
        strokeOpacity: d => d.team_id === team ? 1 : 0.6
      }),
      Plot.dot(focused.rows, Plot.pointer({
        x: "season", y: metric, fill: d => color(d.team_id), r: 6,
        title: d => `${name(d.team_id)} ${d.season}: ${value(d)}, ${formatRecord(d)}`,
        tip: true
      }))
    ]
  });
  fig.addEventListener("click", () => { if (fig.value) pick.team(fig.value.team_id); });
  const back = html`<button type="button" class="explorer-chip">← All conferences</button>`;
  back.onclick = () => { mutable focusConf = null; };
  const chips = html`<div class="explorer-chips"></div>`;
  const now = focused.rows.filter(d => d.season === season).sort((a, b) => b[metric] - a[metric]);
  for (const d of now) {
    const t = ready.teamById.get(d.team_id);
    const chip = html`<button type="button" class="explorer-chip" aria-pressed=${String(d.team_id === team)}>${t?.logo ? html`<img src=${t.logo} alt="" width="24" height="24" loading="lazy">` : ""}${name(d.team_id)} <span>${formatRecord(d)}</span></button>`;
    chip.onclick = () => pick.team(d.team_id);
    chips.append(chip);
  }
  return html`<div>${back}<h4>${focused.conference} in ${season}</h4>${fig}${chips}</div>`;
}
```

::: {.column-margin}
Each line is one team's rating at the end of every season. Membership is as
of the selected season, so a team that changed conference keeps its whole
history on one line. FCS teams have no Elo rating; their panels show **win
share**, $(W + T/2) / G$ over the season's $G$ games.
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
```
```{ojs}
teamView = {
  const info = ready.teamById.get(team);
  const rows = ready.teamSeason.filter(d => d.team_id === team);
  const elo = rows.filter(d => d.elo_end !== null);
  const out = html`<div></div>`;
  if (elo.length) {
    const fig = Plot.plot({
      height: 300, marginLeft: 56, style: {fontSize: "16px"},
      x: {label: "Season", tickFormat: String},
      y: {label: "End-of-season Elo", grid: true},
      marks: [
        Plot.ruleX([season], {stroke: "#9ca3af", strokeDasharray: "4,4"}),
        Plot.line(elo, {x: "season", y: "elo_end", stroke: info.color, strokeWidth: 3}),
        Plot.dot(elo, Plot.pointerX({
          x: "season", y: "elo_end", fill: info.color, r: 7,
          title: d => `${d.season}: Elo ${d.elo_end}, record ${formatRecord(d)}`,
          tip: true
        }))
      ]
    });
    fig.addEventListener("click", () => { if (fig.value) pick.season(fig.value.season); });
    out.append(fig);
  } else {
    out.append(asNode(`<div class="explorer-card">${escapeHtml(info.team)} has no Elo rating: CFBD rates FBS teams only.</div>`));
  }
  // Wins and losses by season; tap a season to open its games.
  const bars = rows.flatMap(d => [
    {season: d.season, outcome: "Wins", n: d.wins},
    {season: d.season, outcome: "Losses", n: d.losses},
    {season: d.season, outcome: "Ties", n: d.ties}
  ]).filter(d => d.n > 0);
  const wl = Plot.plot({
    height: 200, marginLeft: 40, style: {fontSize: "16px"},
    x: {label: "Season", type: "band", tickFormat: d => d % 4 === 2 ? String(d) : ""},
    y: {label: "Games", grid: true},
    color: {domain: ["Wins", "Losses", "Ties"], range: [info.color, "#9ca3af", "#d1d5db"], legend: true},
    marks: [
      Plot.barY(bars, {x: "season", y: "n", fill: "outcome", fillOpacity: d => d.season === season ? 1 : 0.55}),
      Plot.tip(rows, Plot.pointerX({x: "season", y: "games", title: d => `${d.season}: ${formatRecord(d)}`}))
    ]
  });
  wl.addEventListener("click", () => { if (wl.value) pick.season(wl.value.season); });
  out.append(wl);
  return out;
}
```

::: {.column-margin}
**End-of-season Elo** is the team's CFBD Elo rating after its last rated game
of the season. A rating gap of $D$ points gives the higher-rated team an
expected win probability of

$$E = \frac{1}{1 + 10^{-D/400}}$$

so a 100-point edge is about a 64% favorite. Tap a season in either chart to
open its games.
:::

### Season {#teams-season}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
seasonStrip = {
  const info = ready.teamById.get(team);
  if (seasonGamesData.error) {
    const card = asNode(errorCard(`the ${season} games`));
    card.querySelector("button").onclick = () => { mutable teamsRetry = teamsRetry + 1; };
    return card;
  }
  if (!teamSeasonGames.length) {
    const yet = season < ready.meta.default_season ? "" : " yet";
    return asNode(`<div class="explorer-card">${escapeHtml(info.team)} has no completed games in ${season}${yet}.</div>`);
  }
  const rated = teamSeasonGames.map((g, i) => ({...g, i: i + 1})).filter(g => g.elo_post !== null);
  const out = html`<div><h4>${info.team} in ${season}</h4></div>`;
  if (rated.length) {
    out.append(Plot.plot({
      height: 130, marginLeft: 52, style: {fontSize: "14px"},
      x: {label: "Game", ticks: Math.min(rated.length, 8)},
      y: {label: "Elo", grid: true},
      marks: [
        Plot.line(rated, {x: "i", y: "elo_post", stroke: info.color, strokeWidth: 2}),
        Plot.dot(rated, {
          x: "i", y: "elo_post", stroke: info.color,
          fill: d => d.game_id === shownGame ? info.color : "white",
          r: d => d.game_id === shownGame ? 7 : 4
        })
      ]
    }));
  }
  const tiles = html`<div class="explorer-tiles"></div>`;
  for (const g of teamSeasonGames) {
    const opp = ready.teamById.get(g.opp_id);
    const where = g.site === "home" ? "vs" : g.site === "away" ? "at" : "vs (neutral)";
    const label = g.season_type === "regular" ? `Week ${g.week}` : "Postseason";
    const delta = g.elo_delta === null ? "" : `Elo ${g.elo_delta > 0 ? "+" : ""}${g.elo_delta}`;
    const tile = html`<button type="button" class=${`explorer-tile explorer-${g.result}`} aria-pressed=${String(g.game_id === shownGame)}>
      <span class="explorer-tile-week">${label}</span>
      ${opp?.logo ? html`<img src=${opp.logo} alt="" width="32" height="32" loading="lazy">` : ""}
      <span>${where} ${opp?.team ?? g.opp_name}</span>
      <strong>${g.result} ${g.points}-${g.opp_points}</strong>
      <span class="explorer-tile-elo">${delta}</span>
    </button>`;
    tile.onclick = () => pick.game(g.game_id);
    tiles.append(tile);
  }
  out.append(tiles);
  return out;
}
```

::: {.column-margin}
**Elo change** is the rating after the game minus the rating before it. The
mini line shows the rating after each game; the filled dot is the game shown
below.
:::

### Game {#teams-game}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Latch the play-by-play load on the first view of the Game section. The
// observer starts a little before the heading reaches the viewport; a hidden
// tab never intersects, so nothing loads off the Teams tab.
{
  const el = document.getElementById("teams-game");
  if (!el || !("IntersectionObserver" in window)) {
    mutable gameInView = true;
    return;
  }
  const io = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
    if (entries.some(e => e.isIntersecting)) {
      mutable gameInView = true;
      io.disconnect();
    }
  }, {rootMargin: "200px"});
  io.observe(el);
  invalidation.then(() => io.disconnect());
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
gamePlaysData = {
  // Pending until the Teams tab is open and the Game section has been seen.
  if (!gameRow || !shouldLoadPlays({tab, gameInView, hasPlays: gameRow.has_plays})) return {rows: [], pending: true};
  teamsRetry;
  try {
    const hp = await loadHyparquet(teamsRetry);
    // One small shard per season and game_id % 100, fetched whole (GitHub Pages
    // gzips it, so no range reads). The parsed shard is cached, so the other
    // games in it load for free.
    const fileUrl = new URL(playsShardPath(season, gameRow.game_id), document.baseURI).href;
    const shard = await loadOnce(tabCache, fileUrl, () => readShard(hp, fileUrl));
    return {rows: gameRows(shard, Number(gameRow.game_id))};
  } catch (error) {
    return {error, rows: []};
  }
}
timeline = gameRow ? timelineFor(gamePlaysData.rows, gameRow.home) : []
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
gameView = {
  if (!gameRow) return html`<div class="explorer-game"></div>`;
  const info = ready.teamById.get(team);
  const opp = ready.teamById.get(gameRow.opp_id);
  const oppName = opp?.team ?? gameRow.opp_name;
  const pct = p => p === null || p === undefined ? "not rated" : `${Math.round(p * 100)}%`;
  const out = html`<div class="explorer-game">
    <h4>${info.team} ${gameRow.points}, ${oppName} ${gameRow.opp_points}</h4>
    <p class="explorer-summary">Elo win chance before kickoff (neutral field): <strong>${pct(gameRow.wp_pre)}</strong> · CFBD win probability after the game: <strong>${pct(gameRow.wp_post)}</strong></p>
  </div>`;
  if (gamePlaysData.error) {
    const card = asNode(errorCard("this game's plays"));
    card.querySelector("button").onclick = () => { mutable teamsRetry = teamsRetry + 1; };
    out.append(card);
    return out;
  }
  // Header and summary only until the Game section is in view.
  if (gamePlaysData.pending && gameRow.has_plays) return out;
  if (!timeline.length) {
    out.append(asNode(`<div class="explorer-card">No play-by-play for this game.</div>`));
    return out;
  }
  const oppColor = opp?.color ?? "#6b7280";
  const x = {label: null, ticks: [0, 900, 1800, 2700, 3600], tickFormat: s => ["Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "OT"][s / 900] ?? ""};
  const label = info.abbreviation ?? info.team;
  const margin = Plot.plot({
    height: 240, marginLeft: 52, style: {fontSize: "16px"}, x,
    y: {label: `${label} lead`, grid: true},
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#9ca3af"}),
      Plot.line(timeline, {x: "elapsed", y: "margin", curve: "step-after", stroke: info.color, strokeWidth: 3}),
      Plot.dot(timeline.filter(d => d.scoring), {
        x: "elapsed", y: "margin", r: 5,
        fill: d => d.offense_id === team ? info.color : oppColor
      }),
      Plot.dot(timeline.filter(d => d.turnover), {
        x: "elapsed", y: "margin", symbol: "times", r: 7, stroke: "#b91c1c", strokeWidth: 2
      }),
      Plot.ruleX(timeline, Plot.pointerX({x: "elapsed", stroke: "#111827"}))
    ]
  });
  const ppa = Plot.plot({
    height: 200, marginLeft: 52, style: {fontSize: "16px"}, x,
    y: {label: "Cumulative PPA edge", grid: true},
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#9ca3af"}),
      Plot.line(timeline, {x: "elapsed", y: "cum_ppa", stroke: info.color, strokeWidth: 2}),
      Plot.ruleX(timeline, Plot.pointerX({x: "elapsed", stroke: "#111827"}))
    ]
  });
  for (const fig of [margin, ppa]) {
    fig.addEventListener("input", () => { if (fig.value) mutable scrubPlay = fig.value; });
  }
  out.append(margin, ppa);
  return out;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
```
```{ojs}
playCard = {
  // Always an element, never a bare comment: Quarto hides an OJS output whose
  // container is empty or holds only comments, and a later element swap would
  // stay hidden.
  if (!timeline.length) return html`<div class="explorer-play-wrap"></div>`;
  const p = scrubPlay && timeline.includes(scrubPlay) ? scrubPlay : timeline[0];
  const info = ready.teamById.get(team);
  const opp = ready.teamById.get(gameRow.opp_id);
  const ord = ["", "1st", "2nd", "3rd", "4th"];
  const downs = p.down ? ` · ${ord[p.down] ?? p.down} & ${p.distance}` : "";
  const field = p.yards_to_goal !== null && p.yards_to_goal !== undefined ? ` · ${p.yards_to_goal} yards from the end zone` : "";
  const card = html`<div class="explorer-card explorer-play">
    <p><strong>${playWhen(p)}</strong>${downs}${field}</p>
    <p>${info.abbreviation ?? info.team} ${p.team_score}, ${opp?.abbreviation ?? gameRow.opp_name} ${p.opp_score}</p>
    <p>${p.play_text ?? p.play_type}</p>
  </div>`;
  const players = parsePlayers(p.players);
  if (players.length) {
    const chips = html`<div class="explorer-chips"></div>`;
    for (const a of players) {
      const chip = html`<button type="button" class="explorer-chip">${a.name} <span>${a.stat}</span></button>`;
      chip.onclick = () => pick.player(a.id, a.pos);
      chips.append(chip);
    }
    card.append(chips);
  }
  // Prev/Next for keyboard and screen-reader readers; they step from the
  // play shown, and stop at either end.
  const step = (delta, key) => {
    const next = stepPlay(timeline, p, delta);
    navFocus.key = key;
    mutable scrubPlay = next.play;
    playLive.textContent = next.edge === "last" && delta > 0 ? "Last play"
      : next.edge === "first" && delta < 0 ? "First play"
      : playAnnouncement(next.play);
  };
  const nav = html`<div class="explorer-play-nav">
    <button type="button" class="explorer-nav" data-nav="prev" aria-label="Previous play">← Previous play</button>
    <button type="button" class="explorer-nav" data-nav="next" aria-label="Next play">Next play →</button>
  </div>`;
  nav.querySelector('[data-nav="prev"]').onclick = () => step(-1, "prev");
  nav.querySelector('[data-nav="next"]').onclick = () => step(1, "next");
  const wrap = html`<div class="explorer-play-wrap"></div>`;
  wrap.append(card, nav);
  // The card is redrawn on every step, which would drop focus from the button
  // just pressed, so put it back on the same button.
  if (navFocus.key) {
    const key = navFocus.key;
    navFocus.key = null;
    requestAnimationFrame(() => wrap.querySelector(`[data-nav="${key}"]`)?.focus({preventScroll: true}));
  }
  return wrap;
}
```

::: {.column-margin}
**Game clock** runs left to right as elapsed seconds: $(q - 1) \times 900 +
(900 - r)$ for quarter $q$ with $r$ seconds left. Each overtime period gets a
300-second slot.

**Lead** is the selected team's score minus its opponent's after each play.
Filled dots are scoring plays and red crosses are turnovers.

**PPA** (predicted points added) is how much a play changed the offense's
expected points. The **cumulative PPA edge** adds the team's offensive PPA
and subtracts the opponent's, play by play, so it rises while the team is
outplaying its opponent even when the score doesn't move.

Drag across either chart to read any play, or use the Previous and Next
buttons under the play card.
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
```
```{ojs}
swarm = {
  if (playersData.error) {
    const card = asNode(errorCard(`the ${playersGroup.toLowerCase()} stats`));
    card.querySelector("button").onclick = () => { mutable playersRetry = playersRetry + 1; };
    return card;
  }
  if (playersData.pending) return html`<div class="explorer-swarm"></div>`;
  const stat = playersStats.find(s => s.key === statKey) ?? playersStats[0];
  const dots = swarmRows(playersData.rows, {season, key: stat.key, tiers, player});
  if (!dots.length) {
    return asNode(`<div class="explorer-card">No ${escapeHtml(playersGroup.toLowerCase())} has a ranked ${escapeHtml(stat.label.toLowerCase())} line in ${season} in these conferences.</div>`);
  }
  // Wide swarms scroll sideways rather than shrink, so each dot stays tappable.
  const r = 4;
  const w = Math.max(width, Math.min(1600, Math.round(dots.length * 1.4)));
  const ml = 20, mr = 20;
  const values = dots.map(d => Number(d[stat.key]));
  const lo = Math.min(...values), hi = Math.max(...values);
  const span = hi > lo ? hi - lo : 1;
  const px = values.map(v => ml + (v - lo) / span * (w - ml - mr));
  const band = 150;
  const ys = beeswarm(px, r, band);
  const top = Math.max(r * 2, ...ys.map(y => Math.abs(y))) + r + 24;
  const placed = dots.map((d, i) => ({...d, value: values[i], y: top + ys[i]}));
  const chosen = placed.find(d => String(d.player_id) === String(player));
  const chosenTeam = chosen ? ready.teamById.get(chosen.team_id) : null;
  const fig = Plot.plot({
    width: w, height: top * 2 + 30, marginLeft: ml, marginRight: mr, marginTop: 0, marginBottom: 30,
    style: {fontSize: "14px"},
    x: {domain: [lo, hi], label: stat.label, tickFormat: v => formatStat(v, stat.format)},
    y: {type: "identity", axis: null},
    marks: [
      Plot.dot(placed, {
        x: "value", y: "y", r, fill: d => outcomeColor.get(d.outcome) ?? "#9ca3af",
        fillOpacity: 0.85
      }),
      chosen ? Plot.dot([chosen], {
        x: "value", y: "y", r: 9, fill: outcomeColor.get(chosen.outcome),
        stroke: chosenTeam?.color ?? "#111827", strokeWidth: 3
      }) : null,
      chosen ? Plot.text([chosen], {
        x: "value", y: "y", text: "name", dy: -16, fontWeight: "bold", fontSize: 15, fill: "#111827",
        stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 4, paintOrder: "stroke"
      }) : null,
      Plot.tip(placed, Plot.pointer({
        x: "value", y: "y",
        title: d => `${d.name} (${playerTeam(d)})\n${stat.label}: ${formatStat(d.value, stat.format)}, ${ordinal(d[`${stat.key}_pct`])} percentile\n${d.outcome_label}`
      }))
    ]
  });
  fig.addEventListener("click", () => { if (fig.value) pick.player(fig.value.player_id); });
  const scroller = html`<div class="explorer-swarm" tabindex="0" aria-label="${`${groupPlural(playersGroup)}: ${stat.label.toLowerCase()} in ${season}, one dot per player`}">${fig}</div>`;
  // Bring the selected player's dot into view in a swarm wider than the screen.
  if (chosen) requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    const x = ml + (chosen.value - lo) / span * (w - ml - mr);
    scroller.scrollLeft = Math.max(0, x - scroller.clientWidth / 2);
  });
  const legend = html`<div class="explorer-legend">${outcomeLevels.map(o => html`<span><i style="background:${outcomeColor.get(o.outcome)}"></i>${o.label}</span>`)}</div>`;
  return html`<div><h4>${groupPlural(playersGroup)} in ${season}: ${stat.label.toLowerCase()}</h4>${legend}${scroller}<p class="explorer-note">${placed.length.toLocaleString("en-US")} players. Tap a dot to open the player.</p></div>`;
}
```

::: {.column-margin}
Each dot is one player's season. The **percentile** of a value $v$ among the
$n$ players at the position that season is

$$p = 100 \times \frac{\#\{\text{players below } v\}}{n - 1}$$

ranked across every conference, so 90 means the player was ahead of 90% of
the position that season.
Rate stats count only players with enough volume (at least 100 pass attempts,
50 carries, 15 catches for receivers and 10 for tight ends, 10 field goal
tries, 20 punts). Interceptions thrown are ranked in reverse, so a higher
percentile is always better. Where many players share a value, the dots
overlap.
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
```
```{ojs}
careerView = {
  if (player === null) return asNode(`<div class="explorer-card">Tap a dot, search above, or tap a player in a game's play card to see their career.</div>`);
  if (playersData.pending || playersData.error) return html`<div></div>`;
  if (!career.length) return asNode(`<div class="explorer-card">This player has no ${escapeHtml(playersGroup.toLowerCase())} stat line. Try another position.</div>`);
  const last = career.at(-1);
  const out = html`<div class="explorer-career">
    <h4>${last.name}</h4>
    <p><span class="explorer-outcome" style="--c:${outcomeColor.get(last.outcome)}">${last.outcome_label}</span></p>
  </div>`;
  if (!career.some(d => d.season === season)) {
    const b = html`<button type="button" class="explorer-chip">Show ${last.season} in the landscape</button>`;
    b.onclick = () => pick.seasonOnly(last.season);
    out.append(html`<p class="explorer-note">${last.name} has no ${playersGroup.toLowerCase()} line in ${season}. ${b}</p>`);
  }
  const long = careerPercentiles(career, playersStats);
  const seasons = career.map(d => d.season);
  const logos = career.map(d => ({season: d.season, logo: ready.teamById.get(d.team_id)?.logo ?? null, team: playerTeam(d)}));
  out.append(Plot.plot({
    height: 300, marginLeft: 44, marginTop: 40, style: {fontSize: "15px"},
    x: {type: "point", domain: seasons, label: null, tickFormat: String, inset: 20},
    y: {domain: [0, 100], label: "Percentile", grid: true, ticks: [0, 25, 50, 75, 100]},
    color: {legend: true, domain: playersStats.map(s => s.label)},
    marks: [
      Plot.line(long, {x: "season", y: "pct", z: "stat", stroke: "stat", strokeWidth: 2.5}),
      Plot.dot(long.filter(d => d.pct !== null), {x: "season", y: "pct", fill: "stat", r: 4}),
      Plot.image(logos.filter(d => d.logo), {x: "season", frameAnchor: "top", dy: -22, src: "logo", width: 28, title: "team"}),
      Plot.text(logos.filter(d => !d.logo), {x: "season", frameAnchor: "top", dy: -22, text: "team", fontSize: 11}),
      Plot.tip(long.filter(d => d.pct !== null), Plot.pointer({
        x: "season", y: "pct", title: d => `${d.season} ${d.stat}: ${ordinal(d.pct)} percentile`
      }))
    ]
  }));
  const head = playersStats.map(s => `<th scope="col">${escapeHtml(s.label)}</th>`).join("");
  const body = career.map(d => `<tr><th scope="row">${d.season}</th><td>${escapeHtml(playerTeam(d))}</td>` +
    playersStats.map(s => {
      const p = d[`${s.key}_pct`];
      return `<td>${formatStat(d[s.key], s.format)}${p === null || p === undefined ? "" : ` <span>(${ordinal(p)})</span>`}</td>`;
    }).join("") + "</tr>").join("");
  out.append(asNode(`<div class="explorer-table"><table><thead><tr><th scope="col">Season</th><th scope="col">Team</th>${head}</tr></thead><tbody>${body}</tbody></table></div>`));
  return out;
}
```

::: {.column-margin}
Each line is one stat's percentile, season by season, with the team's logo
above each season, so a transfer shows as a logo change. A season without
enough volume for a rate stat leaves a gap. The chip is the player's NFL
outcome: drafted (round and pick), signed as an undrafted free agent, still
playing in college, or no NFL.
:::

```{ojs}
    return {error, rows: []};

}
combineSeasons = {
  const s = combineData.rows.map(d => d.season);
  return s.length ? [Math.min(...s), Math.max(...s)] : [2010, ready.meta.default_season];
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof combineAxes = {
  const opts = new Map(combineMeasures.map(m => [m.label, m.key]));
  const make = (label, value) => Inputs.select(opts, {label, value});
  const xs = make("Left-right axis", "height"), ys = make("Front-back axis", "weight"), zs = make("Up-down axis", "forty");
  const form = html`<div class="explorer-axes">${xs}${ys}${zs}</div>`;
  form.value = [xs.value, ys.value, zs.value];
  for (const el of [xs, ys, zs]) {
    el.addEventListener("input", event => {
      event.stopPropagation();
      form.value = [xs.value, ys.value, zs.value];
      form.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
    });
  }
  return form;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof combineRange = {
  const years = [];
  for (let y = combineSeasons[0]; y <= combineSeasons[1]; y++) years.push(y);
  const from = Inputs.select(years, {label: "From class", value: years[0], format: String});
  const to = Inputs.select(years, {label: "To class", value: years.at(-1), format: String});
  const form = html`<div class="explorer-axes">${from}${to}</div>`;
  form.value = [from.value, to.value];
  for (const el of [from, to]) {
    el.addEventListener("input", event => {
      event.stopPropagation();
      form.value = [from.value, to.value];
      form.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
    });
  }
  return form;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
combinePlot = {
  if (combineData.error) {

    card.querySelector("button").onclick = () => { mutable combineRetry = combineRetry + 1; };

  const byKey = new Map(combineMeasures.map(m => [m.key, m]));
  const title = k => `${byKey.get(k).label} (${byKey.get(k).unit})`;
  const camera = {eye: {x: 1.6, y: 1.6, z: 1.1}};
  const el = html`<div class="explorer-3d-plot"></div>`;
  Plotly.newPlot(el, combineTraces(combineShown, {
    axes: combineAxes, measures: combineMeasures, outcomes: ready.meta.combine_outcomes,
    colors: combineOutcomeColor, selected: player
  }), {
    width, height: Math.min(560, Math.max(420, width)),
    margin: {l: 0, r: 0, t: 0, b: 0},
    font: {size: 14},
    legend: {orientation: "h", y: -0.02, font: {size: 13}},
    scene: {
      camera,
      xaxis: {title: title(combineAxes[0])},
      yaxis: {title: title(combineAxes[1])},
      zaxis: {title: title(combineAxes[2])}
    }
  }, {displaylogo: false, responsive: true, modeBarButtonsToRemove: ["toImage"]});
  el.on("plotly_click", e => {
    const p = e.points?.[0];
    if (p && p.customdata !== undefined) mutable combinePick = combineShown[p.customdata];
  });
  const reset = html`<button type="button" class="explorer-chip">Reset view</button>`;
  reset.onclick = () => Plotly.relayout(el, {"scene.camera": camera});
  const skipped = missingCount(combineData.rows, combineFilter);
  return html`<div class="explorer-3d">
    <h4>${group} invitees, ${Math.min(...combineRange)}–${Math.max(...combineRange)} classes</h4>
    ${el}
    <div class="explorer-chips">${reset}</div>
    <p class="explorer-note">${combineShown.length.toLocaleString("en-US")} invitees with all three measurements${skipped ? `; ${skipped.toLocaleString("en-US")} skipped at least one of these drills and aren't shown` : ""}. Drag to rotate, pinch or scroll to zoom, tap a point for the player.</p>
  </div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
combineCard = {
  // The tapped point, else the selected player if they were at the combine.
  // The selected player may have skipped a drill on these axes: still show
  // their card, with a note.
  const d = combinePick !== null && combineShown.includes(combinePick)
    ? combinePick
    : combineData.rows.find(r => player !== null && r.pos === combinePos && String(r.athlete_id) === String(player));
  if (!d) return html`<div class="explorer-combine-card"></div>`;
  const off = !combineShown.includes(d);
  const rows = combineMeasures.map(m => `<tr><th scope="row">${escapeHtml(m.label)}</th><td>${escapeHtml(formatMeasure(d[m.key], m))}</td></tr>`).join("");
  const card = asNode(`<div class="explorer-card explorer-combine-card">
    <h4>${escapeHtml(d.name)}</h4>
    <p>${escapeHtml(d.school)} · ${escapeHtml(d.combine_pos)} · ${d.season} combine</p>
    ${off ? `<p class="explorer-note">Not in the chart: no measurement on one of these axes, or outside the classes shown.</p>` : ""}
    <p><span class="explorer-outcome" style="--c:${combineOutcomeColor.get(d.outcome)}">${escapeHtml(d.outcome_label)}</span></p>
    <div class="explorer-table"><table><tbody>${rows}</tbody></table></div>
  </div>`);
  if (canOpenPlayer(d)) {
    const b = html`<button type="button" class="explorer-chip">Open ${d.name} in Players →</button>`;
    // The combine follows the last college season, so open that season.
    b.onclick = () => pick.player(d.athlete_id, d.players_pos, d.season - 1);
    card.append(b);
  } else {
    card.append(html`<p class="explorer-note">${d.athlete_id ? "No box-score stat line to show in Players." : "Not linked to a college player record, so there's no Players view."}</p>`);
  }
  return card;
}
```

::: {.column-margin}
Each point is one invitee at the NFL Scouting Combine, colored by what
happened in the draft that spring. Height is in inches, weight in pounds,
the 40-yard dash, shuttle and 3-cone in seconds (lower is faster), the
vertical and broad jumps in inches, and the bench press in repetitions of
225 pounds. Players skip drills, so each view only shows invitees with all
three measurements. Combine numbers are taken after the college career and
describe draft prospects; they are not used to forecast careers.
:::
